title: anthoxanthum clarkei
intro: Anthoxanthum clarkei, commonly known as Clarke's grass or sweet grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Anthoxanthum clarkei include its ability to soothe digestive issues and calm nervous system imbalances, as well as its potential to support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
